## Summary

Describe the server-side change and link the board item from `docs/PROJECT_BOARD.md`.

## Type of change

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Test or CI

## Verification

- [ ] `bun run lint:check`
- [ ] `bun run typecheck`
- [ ] `bun run format:check`
- [ ] `bun run test`
- [ ] `bun run build`
- [ ] API contract or migration changes documented

## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets or `.env` files are included
- [ ] Zod validation added or updated where input changed
- [ ] Authorization checked for new routes
- [ ] Prisma migration included when schema changed
- [ ] Documentation updated when behavior changed
